device.description: 12-bit 1 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC, fully-differential inputs, SPI with programmable REFDACs
device.note: ads7254.pdf (SBAS556B, ADS8354/ADS7854/ADS7254) p.4 pin functions, p.10 DVDD range, p.11-12 serial timing, p.32 transfer function, p.33-35 register write and CFR/REFDAC, p.36 read-back, p.38 32-CLK dual-SDO frame and tCONV, p.43-45 low-power modes

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.34 CFR bits B11..B0 (written with command 1000b, read back with 0011b); all bits 0 at power-up

registers.name: REFDAC_A
registers.note: p.35 REFDAC_A bits B11..B0: D[8:0] in B11:B3, B2:B0 = 0; reset 1FFh per the REFDAC Settings table "(default)" (the field table lists 0h)

commands.name: Enter SPD (SDI high for 48 SCLK)
commands.note: p.43-45 software power-down on the CS rising edge after a frame with SDI high for at least 48 SCLKs

commands.name: Exit SPD (SDI low for 48 SCLK)
commands.note: p.43-45 SDI low for at least 48 SCLKs; power-up starts on CS rising

commands.name: CFR write
commands.note: p.33 Table: B[15:12] = 1000b; takes effect on the CS rising edge of a valid frame

commands.name: CFR read
commands.note: p.36: control word in frame F+1, SDO_A shifts R15..R0 = 0011b + CFR B11..B0 in frame F+2, then 0s

pages: p.4 (pin functions), p.10 (DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.11-12 (serial timing, Figure 1), p.32 (transfer function), p.33 (Table: B[15:12] operations), p.34 (CFR), p.35 (REFDAC), p.36 (register read-back), p.37-42 (conversion data read, 32-CLK dual-SDO Data Launch Edge table, tCONV p.38), p.43-45 (STANDBY, SPD), p.46 (frame abort)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal references and REFDACs: every conversion returns the 0 V code (twos complement 0)
channel B: both ADCs sample simultaneously but only SDO_A (ADC_A result) is modeled; SDO_B (ADC_B result in dual-SDO mode, 3-state in single-SDO mode, 0s during register read-back) is never driven

interface modes from CFR RD_CLK_MODE / RD_DATA_LINES: only the default 32-CLK dual-SDO frame (16 zeros, the result MSB first, zero fill) is modeled; the 32-CLK single-SDO frame (ADC_A then ADC_B on SDO_A, 48 SCLKs) and the 16-CLK modes (2 zeros then the result, conversion clocked by SCLK) are stored only
minimum SCLK count N per frame (16/32/48) for a valid write and the 48-SCLK read-back frames: writes and reads commit at CS rising once their 16 bits are in (fewer bits discard them)

register read-back output timing: the 16-bit word is shifted from CS falling in the frame after the read command (the figure shows R15 before the first SCLK falling edge); the result frame of that transaction is replaced
STANDBY mode (CFR STANDBY = 1: SDO outputs all 1s while CS is low, power-up time tPU_STDBY): the bit is stored only, conversions continue
SPD mode: SDO_A/SDO_B 3-state regardless of CS and the tPU_SPD power-up time; the model only stops conversions
frame abort / short-cycling (CS high before N SCLKs starts a new sample) and the acquisition-time / throughput limits
CFR bits that must be 0 are stored as written
variants: ADS7254/ADS7854/ADS8354 share ads7254.pdf (same pinout, registers and protocol; 12/14/16 bits, tCONV 450/450/640 ns; the 16-bit part supports 32-CLK modes only); own spec each. The ADSxx53 (ads7253.pdf) are the single-ended/pseudo-differential versions.
